_meta.name: planescape-cant-lexicon
_meta.license: Definitions are original paraphrases. Published glossaries (PWHB, PSCS, PS:T) are CITE-ONLY products — no verbatim text from them lives here. Fan-archive sources are credited by URL.

sources.pwhb: The Planewalker's Handbook (TSR 2620), cant glossary — cite-only
sources.pscs: Planescape Campaign Setting, 'Sigil and Beyond' glossary (TSR 2600) — cite-only

tiers.core: corroborated across the published-glossary line (PWHB/PSCS/PST) via >=2 independent archives — safe default vocabulary
tiers.ext: fan-canonical (chiefly mimir.net's dictionary) — spice, use sparingly unless the table asks for heavy cant

curation_notes: planardm's 'Takers = Athar' is an error — Takers are the Fated; corrected here.
mimir.net's post-Faction-War / 5e-era renames (Hands of Havoc, Heralds of Dust, Mind's Eye) are DROPPED — the poured corpus (Uncaged, Factol's Manifesto) is classic boxed-set era.
mimir.net's City of Glass dialect (glassfolk, glasser, wet cage, hende, unhende) is DROPPED — this lexicon is Sigil's cant.

match policy: 'word' (default) auto-attests on word boundary with s/'s/es/ies inflections; 'phrase' attests only on the listed phrases; 'none' is never auto-attested (too common in plain English) — the harvester honors this.
